observations.fact: The current page includes the handing-over meaning here you are, absent from the older pinned English Kaikki excerpt.
ANW categorizes the expression as an interjection; Wiktionary categorizes it as an adverb. Pilot uses interjection as a pedagogical normalized POS and preserves both source labels.
The entry gives alsjeblieft for handing over what someone wants.

observations.locator: Telling the time table: half past two
observations.fact: The time expression half drie denotes 2:30; morning/afternoon requires context.
Both de deksel and het deksel are accepted.

observations.locator: soort as category versus biological species
observations.fact: Category/kind permits de or het; species has de. The legacy category row het soort is not a demonstrated article error.
Strong forms wrocht/gewrocht are archaic. Flattened tables must not promote them as default modern learner forms.

observations.locator: Dutch verb senses, usage note and conjugation
observations.fact: Paying by debit card and withdrawing money are separate senses; PIN entry is not necessary in every use. Weak forms include pinde and gepind.
